get.summary: Read up to ten days of intake within the last three calendar months
get.description: Session-scoped totals, including water. Managed context rechecks ADMIN/EDITOR authorization. The date window uses the requested IANA timezone (default UTC). Returns current targets, not historical snapshots. Missing days have zero totals and zero entry counts. No user identifiers or meal details are returned.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Inclusive end date, defaults to today; future or older-than-three-calendar-month dates return 400.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone for today and bounds.

404.description: Managed member/family context unavailable to this viewer

sessionCookie.name: astitva_session
sessionCookie.description: Dev uses astitva_dev_session; Stage uses astitva_stage_session.

TargetInput.description: Protein, carbohydrate, fat and fiber targets plus water. Server derives whole calorie target with Math.round(proteinGrams*4 + carbohydrateGrams*4 + fatGrams*9). Fiber is separate. Optional legacy calories input is ignored.
